accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the decentralised grain storage plan:
1. It is described as the world’s largest grain storage programme in cooperatives.
2. It envisages construction of storage facilities at the PACS level.
3. It is implemented through the Agriculture Infrastructure Fund, the Agricultural Marketing Infrastructure scheme and other schemes.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The programme is a cooperative-based, PACS-level storage initiative supported through AIF, AMI and other schemes.
accepted.tq: Test a programme through its description, implementation level and funding channels.
accepted.sec: Ministry of Cooperation initiatives - grain storage plan, model bye-laws

accepted.s: The pilot phase of the decentralised grain storage plan covered how many PACS and what storage capacity?
accepted.x: The pilot covered 11 PACS with a storage capacity of 9,750 metric tonnes.
accepted.tq: Match the two linked quantitative figures instead of recalling either figure in isolation.
accepted.sec: Ministry of Cooperation initiatives - grain storage plan, model bye-laws

accepted.s: By July 2026, godowns under the decentralised grain storage plan had been completed in:
accepted.x: By July 2026, godowns had been completed in 313 PACS with storage capacity exceeding 1.80 lakh metric tonnes.
accepted.tq: Read the completed-unit figure together with its corresponding capacity and date.
accepted.sec: Ministry of Cooperation initiatives - grain storage plan, model bye-laws

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the changes made under the grain storage financing arrangement?
o: AMI subsidy was reduced from 33.33% to 25%, while margin money was raised from 10% to 20%.
AMI subsidy was raised from 25% to 33.33%, while margin money was reduced from 20% to 10%.
AMI subsidy and margin money were both fixed at 33.33%.
AMI subsidy was raised from 20% to 25%, while margin money was reduced from 10% to 5%.
accepted.x: The AMI subsidy was increased from 25% to 33.33%, and the margin money requirement was reduced from 20% to 10%.
accepted.tq: Compare the original and revised percentages without reversing the direction of change.
accepted.sec: Ministry of Cooperation initiatives - grain storage plan, model bye-laws

accepted.s: With the benefit of 3% AIF subvention, the effective interest rate payable by PACS under the stated arrangement is:
accepted.x: After the 3% AIF subvention, PACS pay an effective interest rate of 1%.
accepted.tq: Apply the stated subvention outcome rather than selecting the gross financing figure.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Two lakh new multipurpose PACS, dairy and fishery societies are planned.
2. As many as 24,417 such societies have been set up.
3. The outlay for PACS computerisation is Rs 2,925.39 crore.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: the plan covers two lakh societies, 24,417 have been set up, and PACS computerisation has an outlay of Rs 2,925.39 crore.
accepted.tq: Combine a target, an achievement figure and a financial outlay in one coded statement question.
accepted.sec: Ministry of Cooperation initiatives - grain storage plan, model bye-laws

accepted.s: Which of the following is correctly matched with the cooperative initiative or institution?
o: Tribhuvan Sahakari University — India’s first national cooperative university
National Cooperative Organics Ltd — urban cooperative bank development body
NABARD’s Sahakar Sarathi — national cooperative university at Anand
accepted.x: Tribhuvan Sahakari University at IRMA, Anand, is India’s first national cooperative university. NUCFDC is associated with urban cooperative banks, while National Cooperative Exports Ltd and Sahakar Sarathi have different roles.
accepted.tq: Use the correctly matched pair and reject swapped institutional identities.
accepted.sec: Ministry of Cooperation initiatives - grain storage plan, model bye-laws

accepted.s: Tribhuvan Sahakari University, described as India’s first national cooperative university, is located at:
accepted.x: Tribhuvan Sahakari University is located at the Institute of Rural Management Anand (IRMA), Anand.
accepted.tq: Identify the institution through its precise location and institutional association.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding Andhra Pradesh’s cooperative strategy:
1. It includes AIF-funded storage at Rythu Seva Kendras.
2. It provides for procurement centres at Rythu Seva Kendras.
3. It includes godowns under ICDP-II in Chittoor, East Godavari and Kurnool.
4. The ICDP-II godowns involve an amount of Rs 609.39 crore.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. Andhra Pradesh’s strategy covers AIF-funded storage and procurement centres at RSKs, along with ICDP-II godowns in the three named districts involving Rs 609.39 crore.
accepted.tq: Integrate location, institutional platform and expenditure details in a regional-economy question.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: The ICDP-II godowns mentioned in the cooperative strategy of Andhra Pradesh are associated with which set of districts?
accepted.x: The ICDP-II godowns are associated with Chittoor, East Godavari and Kurnool.
accepted.tq: Use district-based recall and avoid substituting nearby Andhra Pradesh districts.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: The amount associated with godowns under ICDP-II in the stated Andhra Pradesh cooperative strategy is:
accepted.x: The ICDP-II godowns involve an amount of Rs 609.39 crore.
accepted.tq: Distinguish closely arranged numerical options by preserving the exact digit sequence.
accepted.sec: Universal angles
